_preregistration.hypothesis: dphi(prefix, model) ~ u_prefix * v_model -- a bilinear effect produces systematic interaction with NO marginal factor, which is the F147-F156 pattern
_preregistration.estimator: rank-1 ALS on observed cells only, SVD warm start discarded after init, 200 iters
_preregistration.masking: cells with |dphi| <= max(4/96, 2*across-seed range) are MASKED: excluded from the fit, never zeroed and never imputed. Zero is a claim and imputation is a louder one, and floored/ceilinged arms are this project's own defect class.
_preregistration.insufficiency: < 60% coverage or < 4 usable columns -> NOT DECIDABLE FOR INSUFFICIENCY, listing the runs that would fill it
also: loadings u and v with signs
_preregistration.boundary: dphi is measured against each file's own raw arm where it has one and against domain_base's raw otherwise; the baseline is recorded per cell

verdict: MATRIX: 8 models x 29 prefix arms from five results files. 137 of 232 cells are usable; the rest split into 84 NEVER MEASURED and 11 measured-but-MASKED (|dphi| within their own tolerance, excluded from the fit -- never zeroed, never imputed). After dropping rows and columns with fewer than two observed cells: 8 models x 29 arms, coverage 59%. ABSENCE vs MASKING: of 232 cells, 84 were NEVER MEASURED (the model was not run on that arm) and 11 were measured and fell within their own tolerance. Only the first kind is a coverage hole a run could fill; the second carries no direction and rerunning it would remeasure a flat quantity. Coverage over MEASURED cells alone is 93%. NOT DECIDABLE FOR INSUFFICIENCY: coverage 59% against the floor of 60% declared before the fit -- it misses by one point, and the threshold is NOT moved to reach a verdict. 29 usable columns clears its floor of 4. The runs that would fill the never-measured cells are LISTED in `would_fill`, cheapest first, and are NOT run here. BOUNDARY: every cell records its file, its arm keys, its baseline keys and its own tolerance. Cells from different files share the estimator and the 96-start geometry but are not assumed commensurable beyond that. Masked cells are excluded, not zeroed.

_analysis_provenance.note: sha256 of the analysis source at write time, plus the repo-local import closure. If any of these does not match the file on disk, the analysis was produced by a different version of the code -- re-run it before reading the numbers (issue #38; the imports half closes the same hole one level down the import graph). Third-party package versions are NOT covered.
